source_proof.proof: Moe passes identical const float* x and n_tokens to shared GatedDense and later MoeExperts/GatedExperts. Shared Q8 GatedDense prepares x once. Intervening shared down projection prepares s_.shexp_up into the alternate q8 slot. Two alternating slots preserve the earlier x preparation through one subsequent Quantize. The routed wrapper then currently quantizes x again. Router is SmallGemm float-input and contributes no quantize node in these graph ranges.

Routed wrapper uses K strides with ne1=1, ne2=n_tokens. Public preparation uses ne1=n_tokens, ne2=1 with same padded K. Both call quantize_row_q8_1_hip. One routed quantized buffer is already shared by both gate/up weights and all expert IDs.

Flattened source is row*K+i0 and output is row*paddedK+i0 for either y-row or z-row grid orientation. Quantization is same 32-lane max/sum, d=amax/127, roundf(x/d), int8 values, half2(d,sum). type_src0 is explicitly unused, so Q8_0 versus Q4_K caller type does not change vector quantization.
